#define MAXN 250005

int Mod;

int fast_pow(int base, int exp) {
    LL result = 1, cur = base;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = result * cur % Mod;
        cur = cur * cur % Mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return (int)result;
}

int n, k;
int factorial[MAXN], inv_factorial[MAXN], inverse[MAXN], f[19][MAXN];

int compute(int used, int S) {
    if (f[used][S] != -1) return f[used][S];
    int answer = 0;
    if (S == 0) {
        answer = factorial[n];
        for (int i = 1; i <= used; ++i)
            answer = (int)((long long)answer * (k - i + 1) % Mod);
        return f[used][S] = answer;
    }
    if (used > k) return 0;
    int lowest_bit = S & (-S);
    int remaining = S - lowest_bit;
    for (int T = remaining; ; T = (T - 1) & remaining) {
        answer = (answer + (long long)inv_factorial[S - T] * compute(used + 1, T) % Mod) % Mod;
        if (T == 0) break;
    }
    return f[used][S] = answer;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &k, &Mod);
    if (n % 2 == 1) {
        printf("%d\n", fast_pow(k, n));
        return 0;
    }
    factorial[0] = inv_factorial[0] = 1;
    factorial[1] = inv_factorial[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        factorial[i] = (int)((long long)factorial[i - 1] * i % Mod);
        inverse[i] = (int)((long long)(Mod - Mod / i) * inv_factorial[Mod % i] % Mod);
        inv_factorial[i] = (int)((long long)inv_factorial[i - 1] * inverse[i] % Mod);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= 18; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j)

    printf("%d\n", (fast_pow(k, n) - compute(0, n) + Mod) % Mod);
    return 0;
